title: A Choir for the Visitor
author: R. M. Pemberton
blurb: Petra Thornbury, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
